columns.name: sku
columns.description: SKU addressing key; NOT NULL, part of the (sku, location) unique pair (PI2-location-key-preserved). Unchanged by this migration.

columns.name: location
columns.description: Location addressing key; NOT NULL, part of the (sku, location) unique pair (PI2-location-key-preserved). Never mutated by the split (AC8).

columns.name: batch_number
columns.description: Batch segment split out of inventory_code (AC1/AC2). NULLABLE (PI1-batch-serial-nullable): nonconforming codes persist NULL rather than an invented value (AC4).

columns.name: serial_number
columns.description: Serial segment split out of inventory_code (AC1/AC2). NULLABLE (PI1-batch-serial-nullable): nonconforming codes persist NULL (AC4).

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Stored stock level; NOT NULL, CHECK >= 0 (inherited from F1, unmodified by this feature per NFR-F6-8).

schema_changes.detail: Add batch_number (text, NULLABLE) and serial_number (text, NULLABLE) to stock_records. Both nullable so nonconforming codes can hold NULL (AC1, AC4, PI1-batch-serial-nullable).
schema_changes.migration_note: Expand phase (step 1 of expand/contract). Additive only, no rows touched. Downgrade drops both columns.

schema_changes.detail: Backfill: for each row whose inventory_code parses as location-batch-serial, write the batch segment to batch_number and the serial segment to serial_number; leave both NULL where the code does not conform (AC2, AC4). Never write location from the code (AC8, PI2-location-key-preserved). No row is deleted, so every pre-migration row is preserved (AC5, PI3-rows-preserved).
schema_changes.migration_note: Backfill runs after add_column and before the inventory_code drop (NFR-F6-6). A pre-acceptance probe counts rows where batch_number/serial_number remain NULL after backfill to surface the nonconforming count for operator review (AC6, NFR-F6-5).

schema_changes.detail: Drop the combined inventory_code column after backfill completes (AC3). Contract phase.
schema_changes.migration_note: Contract phase (step 3 of expand/contract), executed only after batch_number/serial_number are populated (NFR-F6-6). Downgrade re-adds inventory_code and reconstructs its value from location + batch_number + serial_number, restoring the pre-migration schema shape (AC7, PI3-rows-preserved, NFR-F6-4).
